reviewActions.reportHint: Tell us what is wrong. An administrator will look at it. Your name is not shown to the reviewer.
reviewActions.reportedThanks: Thank you. We have sent this review to an administrator to look at.
reviewActions.replyHint: Your reply is shown under the review for everyone to read. You can change it later.
reviewActions.failed: We could not do that just now. Check your connection and try again.

errors.RV_NOT_YOUR_REVIEW: You can only reply to reviews written about you.
errors.RV_NOT_FOUND: This review is no longer available. Refresh the page to see the current reviews.
errors.RV_OWN_REVIEW: This is your own review, so you cannot mark it helpful or report it.
